indications: Donepezil Hydrochloride tablets are indicated for the treatment of dementia of the Alzheimer’s type. Efficacy has been demonstrated in patients with mild, moderate, and severe Alzheimer’s disease.
contraindications: • Mild to Moderate Alzheimer’s Disease: 5 mg to 10 mg once daily • Moderate to Severe Alzheimer’s Disease: 10 mg to 23 mg once daily
adverseReactions: Donepezil Hydrochloride Tablets are contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to donepezil hydrochloride or to piperidine derivatives.
name: Donepezil Hydrochloride
